resources.string:
MigraineGuard reads the Health Connect records you allow for your activity, recovery and optional wellness context. Compatible Samsung, Garmin, Fitbit / Google Health and other source apps must share records into Health Connect first. This is not a live watch connection.

Ordinary reads work while the app is open. Optional movement reminders can separately request background Steps access to skip a break prompt after recent shared activity. Missing data uses a timed reminder; it cannot prove you were sitting.

Your account journals and body progress stay in private storage on this phone. Optional backup writes to your own private Google Drive app data; body photos require a separate inclusion switch. No developer health-data server is used. Body progress photos are never sent to AI.

Optional cloud AI uses your selected provider and key. Sharing a health summary or a meal/equipment photo requires the corresponding explicit choice. Otherwise on-device assistance is available. Android automatic backup/device transfer is disabled; manual exports are in Settings → Data.

You can revoke health permissions in Android Settings. Google sign-in, Drive backup and device-health access are separate choices.
Track migraines, hydration, fitness, sleep, weather pressure, and food triggers — calmly.
